## Highlights
- **🕒 Updated time in the Gradebook tab.** On any class page, the **Gradebook** tab now has an **Updated** row at the bottom showing when each grade was entered or last changed, with the date and time (like "10/28 · 3:00 PM").

## Changes
- **Updated row:** one entry under each graded assignment. Assignments that aren't graded yet stay blank.
- **Hover a score box** to see the grade and its updated time together.
- Also new today: the Overview page's **New & Updated Assignments** shows each row's updated time and grade (2.15.1), and **New grade alerts** notify you when a grade is posted or changed (2.15).

## How to update
1. Download the zip below and unzip it.
2. Copy its files over your old Alma+ folder (same place, same folder name).
3. Go to `chrome://extensions` and click reload ↻ on Alma+, then refresh Alma.
4. Open any class and click the **Gradebook** tab.

> ⚠️ Don't remove the extension to update — removing it deletes your saved tasks. Back up your tasks first with **Back up tasks** on the To Do page if you're unsure.
